project_name: BRS Management Solutions LLC — Cinematic Launch & Countdown Experience
context: Marketing / Launch Page (Single-screen full viewport experience with optional details section)

hierarchy.brand_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-[0.3em] uppercase font-serif text-amber-200/90
hierarchy.countdown_numbers: text-4xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-100 via-amber-300 to-yellow-600 drop-shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(217,119,6,0.4)]
hierarchy.countdown_labels: text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.25em] uppercase font-sans text-amber-400/80 font-semibold

controls_and_layout.header_nav: Fixed top bar with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40 border-b border-amber-500/10 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50
controls_and_layout.control_panel: Floating glass pill or bottom-center bar with controls: Replay Intro Button, Formation Selector (Circular Halo vs Cinematic Oval), Audio Toggle Hook, Reduced Motion indicator
controls_and_layout.countdown_clock: Centrally framed element aligned inside the Cinematic Oval or Circular Halo canvas region
controls_and_layout.responsive_rules: Mobile viewport padding p-4, max-h-[80vh] for visual assets, stack countdown units gracefully on small screens (2x2 grid on tiny mobile, 1x4 horizontal row on sm+)

sequence_timing.phase_1_meteor: 0ms - 1200ms: Diagonal golden shooting star streaks at extreme speed across full screen, peak brightness, screen shake (intensity 12px blur + 8px offset), flash layer, dramatic shockwave ring.
sequence_timing.phase_2_star_formation: 1200ms - 4500ms: 5-pointed golden stars emerge from shockwave origin, traverse curved bezier choreography paths into selected formation (Cinematic Oval default or Circular Halo), twinkle & orbit smoothly.
sequence_timing.phase_3_countdown_reveal: 3500ms - 5000ms: Framer motion fade-in and scale-up of countdown clock, BRS brand title, and action controls.

motion_and_effects.canvas_meteor_specs: Shockwave expansion radius r: 0 -> max(width, height)*0.8, screen shake duration 350ms, particle trail length 300px with gold/warm-white gradient.
motion_and_effects.star_shape_specs: Draw true 5-pointed stars (outer radius, inner radius 0.4*outer radius, filled with metallic gold radial gradient and outer blur).
motion_and_effects.particles_js_integration: tsParticles background layer beneath canvas stars with low opacity floating gold Dust/Constellation particles and subtle cursor repulsion/attraction.
motion_and_effects.audio_cue_system: AudioHook context/event emitter exposing onMeteorStreak, onShockwave, onStarsFormed, onTimerTick for seamless audio attachment later.

media_assets.description: Dark luxury background with gold sparkles

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers for automated verification
testing_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Detect prefers-reduced-motion; if enabled, skip meteor streak and jump directly to static star formation and countdown reveal.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all React files use .js extension.
Do NOT change the luxurious black-and-gold color palette.
Integrate tsParticles for the ambient floating particle background.
Maintain the two star formation modes: Cinematic Oval (default on load) and Circular Halo.
Set the target launch date to 30 days from current time by default.
Include full data-testid attributes on key control elements.
